name: calendar-availability-image
title: Calendar Availability Image
description: Renders an anonymized week view of your free time slots from a published ICS calendar and copies it to the clipboard.
author: alexander-krause-glau

commands.name: copy-availability
commands.title: Copy Calendar Availability Image
commands.description: Renders the upcoming weeks as an image without event titles and copies it to the clipboard.

preferences.name: icsUrl
preferences.title: ICS Link
preferences.description: Published ICS link of your calendar, e.g. from Outlook on the web (Settings → Calendar → Shared calendars) or Google Calendar (secret address in iCal format).

preferences.name: weeks
preferences.title: Time Range
preferences.description: Number of weeks, starting with the current week.

preferences.name: endHour
preferences.title: Workday End (Hour)
preferences.description: End of the range shown, e.g. 18.

preferences.name: minSlotMinutes
preferences.title: Shortest Free Slot
preferences.description: Free gaps shorter than this are not marked as free.

preferences.name: tentativeIsBusy
preferences.title: Tentative Events
preferences.label: Treat as busy
preferences.description: When off, tentatively accepted events remain visible as free time.

preferences.name: includeWeekend
preferences.title: Weekend
preferences.label: Show Saturday and Sunday
preferences.description: Shows seven instead of five days per week.
